findings.conflicting_source: tools/art_generate.py prompt_for(): final = ["Specific pitfalls to avoid:"] + ["* " + x for x in b["avoid"]]. Every brief "avoid" item is printed under that header. 106 of the 930 avoid items do not start with No/Not/Do not/Never/Avoid/Without; about 28 are anatomy or weapon REQUIREMENTS.
findings.evidence: Rendered prompt for the queued anchor ART-MON-UNDEAD-CHAMPION (production/art/gpt/prompts/ART-MON-UNDEAD-CHAMPION.txt): "Specific pitfalls to avoid: ... * Weapon is a two-handed war maul of fused bone: no axe blade." Read literally, the model is told to avoid the war maul. Same for Tarantula (queued anchor): "* Spiders have exactly eight legs." Crocodile prints "* Four legs." under the avoid header.
findings.fix: In prompt_for, route avoid items that do not match ^(no|not|do not|don't|never|avoid|without)\b to a separate "MUST KEEP:" list printed before "Specific pitfalls to avoid:". Or rewrite the 28 briefs as negatives ("Not seven or nine legs", "Not a greataxe"). Regenerate the queue; the two queued anchors change hash.

pipeline.title: Batch-phase references are Git LFS PNGs and INSTRUCTIONS.md never says to fetch them
pipeline.evidence: art_gpt_pack batch: refs = ANCHORS.json references = assets/art/incoming/<anchor>.png (LFS, .gitattributes line 3) plus ART-BAS-GREYTHORN.jpg (plain blob). A clone without git-lfs holds 130-byte pointer files. The anchors-phase references (assets/art/style/*.jpg) are plain blobs and work. art_intake.py already raises "LFS pointer; run git lfs pull first" and the workflow runs git lfs pull.
pipeline.fix: Add to INSTRUCTIONS.md step 1: `git lfs install && git lfs pull --include="assets/art/incoming/*.png" --exclude=""`. Or store approved-anchor reference copies as plain JPEGs under assets/art/style/.

pipeline.title: Batch references drop the three owner style samples
pipeline.evidence: art_gpt_pack: batch refs = anchors["references"] only (6 images). art_generate.anchor_refs (the retired Gemini route) appends CFG["style_refs"]; the GPT pack does not. INSTRUCTIONS says "match the reference images" and the owner samples define the hatching.
pipeline.fix: In art_gpt_pack batch branch use `anchors["references"] + g.CFG["style_refs"]` (9 images, or the 4 best + 3 samples if ChatGPT limits attachments).

pipeline.title: No `git pull --rebase` before push, but the intake workflow pushes to main after every image push
pipeline.evidence: .github/workflows/art-intake.yml commits "art: intake of ChatGPT Work images" to main; INSTRUCTIONS says "Pull main" once per session and "Commit and push to main after every 5-10 images". The second push will be rejected non-fast-forward; CLAUDE.md forbids force-push and branches.
pipeline.fix: Add: "Before each push run `git pull --rebase origin main`; if the push is rejected, repeat. Never force-push."

pipeline.title: LFS commit mechanics and file extension are unstated
pipeline.evidence: .gitattributes tracks assets/art/incoming/*.png as LFS only. If Work commits through the GitHub contents API or a client without git-lfs, PNGs enter history as raw blobs (intake still reads them, but `git lfs ls-files` and later checkouts warn). INSTRUCTIONS says save unmodified "as assets/art/incoming/<ID>.png ... no format conversion", yet the Greythorn render arrived as JPEG/WebP (RECEIPTS.jsonl line 1, SELECTIONS.json). art_intake.scan accepts .png .jpg .jpeg .webp and the queue always says .png.
pipeline.fix: State: "If the download is not PNG, keep its true extension (.jpg/.webp); the intake accepts those but they are not LFS. Use a git client with git-lfs installed so PNGs become pointers (`git lfs ls-files` must list your file)."

pipeline.title: Receipts: format matches the intake, but nothing checks the prompt hash or the aspect
pipeline.evidence: Receipt keys id, prompt_sha256, surface, model, notes are the ones art_intake.receipts() reads (match). QUEUE prompt_sha256 is the hash of the prompt text WITHOUT the trailing newline; the prompt file ends with "\n", so sha256(file) differs (verified: hash of file.rstrip() equals the queue value for all 5 items). scan() never compares the receipt hash with the current prompt hash, so an image made from a stale prompt is accepted, and it records pixel size but does not flag an aspect that deviates from the family aspect.
pipeline.fix: Tell Work to copy the hash from QUEUE.json, never recompute (already implied). In scan(), warn when receipt sha != current prompt sha and when |w/h - family aspect| > 5 percent.

pipeline.title: Pixel sizes cannot be set in the ChatGPT interface
pipeline.evidence: INSTRUCTIONS step 3: "Generate at the item's size (1536x1024, 1024x1536 or 1024x1024)". Aspect words are in every prompt ("Wide 3:2 landscape", "Square 1:1", "Tall 2:3 portrait"), and SIZES in art_gpt_pack is consistent with the family aspects.
pipeline.fix: Add: "If the tool cannot fix pixels, request the aspect in words and keep the closest of 1536x1024 / 1024x1536 / 1024x1024."

pipeline.title: docs and config disagree on chapter width; hash and list state
pipeline.evidence: docs/ART_AUTOMATION.md "chapter openers print about 5.1 in wide" vs config print_w_in 5.8 (see F23).

pipeline.title: Items that were checked and pass
